flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui utils/Meta/System.ts (ATOMS_OFFENCE with no Route in App.tsx), pages/System/{list/ParameterList,form/ParameterForm}.tsx; ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsChangeOfProcessing/{AmountPayableCalculationService,ChangeOfProcessingService,ChangeOfProcessingController}, crud/ocmsizdb/parameter/ParameterController, workflows/cas_integration/{CasIntegrationController,service/CasIntegrationServiceImpl}, config/WebConfig; ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/agencies/toppan/upload/helpers/ToppanUploadHelper (RR3/DR3 -> CPC without SUR). ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: atoms_flag is only read for payment, no configuration
note: Story status: Demo paid (50% of 75%). Requirement text is given. There is no ATOMS screen (the 'Atoms Offence' menu is registered in Meta without a Route). What exists: the extra court amount is stored as parameter SUR per stage and the formula composition + SUR is used when the stage changes to CPC/CSD/CSR/COS/COM (ticket OCMS-SR-2026-107, closed, prod deployed), and an external system can also send the court amount through /plus-payment-activation. Gaps: after the court summons payment due date passes there is only a job that closes payment acceptance (payment_acceptance_allowed='N') and it is not scheduled (the scheduler call is commented out), no amount changes automatically; the automatic Toppan path does not add SUR; and the term ATOMS in code is only a Y/N flag. SUR rows in the DB and the identity of the calling system (State Courts/CAS): cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Claim only a small part: the $X + composition formula at the court stage exists and X can be changed through the Parameter page. The ATOMS screen is missing and the trigger after the due date only closes payment (job not scheduled); do not claim a full feature. Confirm with URA what was demoed and who triggers the move to the court stage

steps.step: Officer opens a configuration page for the ATOMS amount payable at the court processing stage
steps.detail: System.ts defines ATOMS_OFFENCE ('Atoms Offence', path /system/atoms-offence, System.ts:17, 51, 143-146), but App.tsx:375-500 registers no Route for it (only parameter, standardcode, computer-rule-code, suspension-reason, schedule-public-holiday), so there is no screen. The word ATOMS in code only appears as the atoms_flag Y/N on notices and transactions (OcmsValidOffenceNotice.java:156-157, OcmsWebTransactionDetail.java:44-45); there is no ATOMS configuration entity or endpoint. Synonyms searched: atoms, court amount, surcharge, State Courts in both UI and API. The extra court amount can be set through the generic Parameter page (step 2).

steps.step: Officer sets the extra amount ($X) for the court stage
steps.detail: The extra amount is stored as parameter SUR per stage (parameter_id='SUR', code=CPC/CSD/CSR/COS/COM, AmountPayableCalculationService.java:39-41, 199-209) and can be changed through the generic Parameter page (App.tsx:377-399, ParameterForm.tsx:72-82; PATCH only description and value, ParameterController.java:90-134), with authorization OCMS_SYSTEM_PARAMETER. No screen mentions ATOMS or State Courts, and there is no number validation (ValidParameter.ts:46 only requires a value; a non-numeric value causes a NumberFormatException that is swallowed and the surcharge is skipped, AmountPayableCalculationService.java:231-233). SUR rows per stage in the DB: cannot verify from repo. Ticket OCMS-SR-2026-107 (closed, prod deployed) added the surcharge at the court stage.

steps.step: At the court processing stage the amount payable = $X + composition amount
steps.detail: When the stage changes to CPC, CSD, CSR, COS or COM (SystemConstant.java:105-107), calculateAmountPayable returns composition amount + the SUR surcharge of the target stage (AmountPayableCalculationService.java:121-124, 199-209); CFC is excluded. ChangeOfProcessingService applies it in POST /change-processing-stage: amount_payable is set (ChangeOfProcessingService.java:1003-1010) and the surcharge is also saved in the VON surcharge column (ChangeOfProcessingService.java:1016-1027). The same calculation is used in staff and manual furnish (StaffFurnishService.java:245, 409; ManualFurnishServiceImpl.java:459). If the SUR row is missing, the result silently becomes the composition amount only, with an error log (AmountPayableCalculationService.java:201-205).

steps.step: The court amount takes effect automatically after the court summons payment due date has passed
steps.detail: The trigger after the due date exists but only closes payment, it does not change the amount: PaymentAcceptanceCutoffServiceImpl selects notices whose court_payment_due_date <= now (OcmsCourtCaseRepository.java:13-19) and sets payment_acceptance_allowed='N' on VON (PaymentAcceptanceCutoffServiceImpl.java:55, 79-82); amount_payable and the stage are not changed. The job is also not scheduled: its call in ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:123 is commented out, so it only runs through the manual trigger POST /payment-acceptance-cutoff/execute (PaymentAcceptanceCutoffController.java:28-48). courtPaymentDueDate is filled from /plus-payment-activation (CasIntegrationServiceImpl.java:803-823). No cron moves a notice to a court stage after the due date; the automatic Toppan RR3/DR3 path sets next stage CPC (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1815-1819) but writes amount_payable = composition (+ admin fee) without SUR (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1390-1423). The SUR calculation only runs when staff change the stage or through furnish (step 3). Property values on the real server: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The amount set by the State Courts is received by OCMS as the amount payable
steps.detail: POST /plus-payment-activation (CasIntegrationController.java:220-221) accepts amountPayable, paymentAcceptanceAllowed and courtPaymentDueDate per notice (max 10) and updates VON and eVON (CasIntegrationServiceImpl.java:762-835), so a court amount can indeed be set from outside OCMS. But it is a value sent by the calling system, not an officer configuration, and it is not checked against fine amount + composition amount. The /v1/plus-* endpoints are excluded from the authorization interceptor (WebConfig.java:78-91) and JwtFilter; their protection depends on APIM, which is not visible in the repo. That the caller is the State Courts/CAS system: cannot verify from repo.
